notes.title: Version 1.3306
Major Update! Build 1.6401
Update 1.6320 April 22, 2025
Airport Madness 3D Update 1.6104: Larger explosions and improved visuals!
notes.notes:
We've added a bunch to both volumes of Airport Madness 3D.  While we do plan to add more fields soon, for now we've sharpened up the aircraft models to have a higher level of detail.  All airports have been given more buildings, better trees, more static vehicles, including static aircraft.  

The explosions are what we are most proud of.  Some may call it unrealistic, but dang.  The explosion is huge.  Lots more shrapnel, smoke, flames, and even flying ragdoll bodies can be seen.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12048796/f38721b7ddabfdd7bad92f3a05f2d905c3029689.jpg[/img]

We think you'll appreciate this update :)

Update 1.402 Available Now!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing!  We've added an 8th airport.  It's Boston Logan, and its our favorite airport by far.  This airport will provide you with more than enough runways and conflict points to keep you stressed out for hours.  It's best played with coffee!

[img]http://www.bigfatsimulations.com/imageHost/bostonPic5.jpg[/img]

We have also added a "Hide UI" feature.  Go ahead and tap the H button during play, and you'll get a full view.   Great for taking screenshots!

Oh, and we fixed up the in-game Achievements Page to be much tidier.  Vancouver has some important bug fixes, as well as the Castlegar high score system.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.350 Available Now!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing!  We've improved game performance, which will be most noticeable on older machines.  Several of our airports have received minor improvements to appearance.  Tags have also been redesigned, and we've added an "auto tag" feature that prevents tag overlap in congested areas.

[img]http://www.bigfatsimulations.com/imageHost/newKJ_smallFile.jpg[/img]

Oh, and we've also improved the gate design, and added a Beech King Air.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.203 Available Now!
notes.notes:
We've added forest fire activity to our newest airport, Castlegar!  New challenges that revolve around fighting this fire have also been added. Plus, there are six new aircraft (DC10, DC6, B737, GLF6, SW4, and BER2) which brings the total number of aircraft to 20!  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12048796/f04ffa74a038327679ecf4a92ba8a82b88b14470.jpg[/img]

Aircraft data tags are now color-coded, allowing players to see speed assignment and aircraft type at a glance.  We've also fixed a few traffic jams, squashed some pesky bugs, and improved texture quality of several aircraft.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12048796/531ec61a134d0604b957a39ac813948048331361.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.08
notes.notes:
We've made lots of minor tweaks, and added some new features.  Thank you for playing!
[list]
    [*]Immediate takeoffs added
    [*]Right click an aircraft to view type, distance and speed information
    [*]Modified the time-trial achievement - now only 30 planes required
    [*]Improved runway deceleration characteristics
    [*]Selected aircraft now gets highlighted
    [*]WASD keyboard control of all cameras
    [*]added SHIFT-WASD motion to sky cam
    [*]Rocky Mountain apron jams alleviated
    [*]Adjusted arrival paths to reduce collisions at spawn
    [*]Reduced/eliminated arrivals that occasionally circle
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.notes:
We've made lots of little tweaks to Airport Madness 3D since its launch yesterday morning.  Look forward to regular updates!
[list]
    [*]Eliminated floating aircraft tags
    [*]Fixed issue with Sky Cam being inaccessible from cockpit view
 [*]Fixed unusual stress meter readings
 [*]Twitter feed more accurate of player performance
 [*]More responsive camera zoom
 [*]Control room settings option renamed "Radar Overlay"
[*]Jamaica Runway 12 go arounds fixed 
    [*]Fixed DH8 taxi path in Jamaica (over grass)
[/list]
